import os, shutil, subprocess, sys

ROOT = "C:/Windows/Temp/vc_verify/proj"
shutil.rmtree("C:/Windows/Temp/vc_verify", ignore_errors=True)
os.makedirs(ROOT)

open(os.path.join(ROOT, "demo.py"), "w").write(
    "def func():\n    '''doc'''\n    return 1\n"
)
open(os.path.join(ROOT, "conf.py"), "w").write(
    "import os, sys\n"
    "sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath('.'))\n"
    "extensions = ['sphinx.ext.viewcode']\n"
    "master_doc = 'index'\n"
)
open(os.path.join(ROOT, "index.rst"), "w").write(
    "Test\n====\n\n.. py:module:: demo\n\n.. py:function:: func\n"
)

env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH="C:/Users/agent/work/work/sphinx-8721-panel")
def build(builder, out):
    r = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "sphinx", "-b", builder,
         "-d", os.path.join(ROOT, "doctrees"), ROOT, os.path.join(ROOT, out)],
        capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    print(f"--- {builder} exit={r.returncode}")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(r.stdout[-2000:]); print(r.stderr[-2000:]); sys.exit(1)

build("html", "out_html")
build("epub", "out_epub")

html_mod = os.path.exists(os.path.join(ROOT, "out_html", "_modules"))
epub_mod = os.path.exists(os.path.join(ROOT, "out_epub", "_modules"))
print(f"html _modules exists: {html_mod}")
print(f"epub _modules exists: {epub_mod}")
assert html_mod, "html should still create module pages"
assert not epub_mod, "BUG: epub created _modules pages despite viewcode_enable_epub=False"
print("PASS: epub creates no _modules pages by default")
